verdict.rationale: Metorial documents a catalog of 1200+ integrations, admin-approved portal integrations, and monitoring of hosted servers. None of that is a published quality signal developers can use to compare servers, such as usage counts, health or liveness indicators, scores, or verification badges. Admin approval and internal monitoring are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges
